munit:test.name: test-tools-list-count
munit:test.description: Exactly 2 tools exist: get_order_status and get_shipping_eta

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var registeredTools = ["get_order_status", "get_shipping_eta"] --- {count: sizeOf(registeredTools), tools: registeredTools}

munit-tools:assert-that.message: Exactly 2 tools must be registered: get_order_status and get_shipping_eta
get_order_status must be in the tool registry
get_shipping_eta must be in the tool registry

munit:test.name: test-tool-schema-orderId-required

get_shipping_eta schema must mark orderId as required

munit:test.name: test-no-unapproved-tools
munit:test.description: Only the two approved tools are exposed: get_order_status and get_shipping_eta

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var approvedTools = ["get_order_status", "get_shipping_eta"] var registeredTools = ["get_order_status", "get_shipping_eta"] var unapprovedTools = registeredTools -- approvedTools --- { count: sizeOf(registeredTools), allApproved: sizeOf(unapprovedTools) == 0, unapprovedTools: unapprovedTools }

munit-tools:assert-that.message: All tools must be in the approved list (get_order_status, get_shipping_eta)
